threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still check the Tube app for delays like it's gospel, while the rest of us just ignore it and cycle past. Welcome to Hackney!
Caught the N35 last night; the driver stopped for a group of pigeons crossing the road. Never seen that before on a night bus!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when I saw a guy in socks and sandals arguing with a pigeon over a leftover kebab on Sonnenallee.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain will you find a park where locals set up mini outdoor cinemas, complete with blankets and popcorn, right under the stars.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by the way they navigate around the BART delays without missing a beat—while newcomers stand around baffled at the schedule.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Just saw a guy juggling on the bus while debating the best burrito in the Mission—definitely a classic San Francisco moment. It’s these oddities that keep us sane!

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think every bar has free tapas, but most locals just sip their vermut without a plate in sight. It's all about the company.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can spot them easily: just look for the ones staring at the metro map like it's a treasure map, utterly confused by the L1 and L3 lines.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'the Tube' without the London accent. Locals say 'the underground' and avoid eye contact at all costs.
Caught a glimpse of a bloke on the 35 bus, serenading a stray cat under the streetlamp. Only in Brixton would that not even raise an eyebrow.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I stepped onto the U7, packed with kids blasting their playlists and a stray cat lounging on the platform. Only in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You can buy a beer and a döner from a kiosk at 3 AM while waiting for the night bus—Berlin’s late-night hustle is unmatched.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s local when they subtly avoid eye contact with the crazy guy singing opera on the corner of 24th and Mission. It's like a rite of passage.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a dude in a full suit calmly reading a newspaper while Muni sat dead in the tunnel. Only in SF does the chaos seem so serene.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think the local bars close early. But if you wander deep enough, some don’t get busy until after midnight, especially on weekends.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can spot them in Gràcia when they ask for 'tap water' at restaurants, still baffled by the 'sin gas' and 'con gas' labels.
